stories.title: ‘Share our good fortune’: Charity feeds Thanksgiving feast to 750 homeless people
stories.summary: The dining hall at Catholic Charities of Southern Nevada was abuzz with Thanksgiving cheer as hundreds of homeless gathered to share a free holiday meal.

stories.title: NFL Friday prediction: Personal personnel move will hurt Steelers vs. Broncos
stories.summary: But the show must go on, and it will do so with Rudolph facing a strong Broncos defense. Rodgers, meanwhile, will be released.

stories.title: College football predictions: Florida, North Dakota State among Friday’s best plays
stories.summary: Florida State enjoyed a slight bump after moving on from former coach Mike Norvell, but that momentum appears to be gone following an 18-point home loss to NC State.

stories.title: Suspect in custody after fleeing Las Vegas police, striking multiple patrol vehicles
stories.summary: A suspect was taken into custody after fleeing from police and striking multiple patrol vehicles Thanksgiving morning in the northwest Las Vegas Valley.

stories.title: Las Vegas native Rome Odunze spoils bettor’s $1M Lions wager on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: A Las Vegas sports bettor went all-in on the Lions on Thanksgiving — a $1 million bet on Detroit — that was spoiled by Bishop Gorman alumnus and Bears wide receiver Rome Odunze.

stories.title: After Boise teen’s death, this ER doctor is being sued. It’s not the first time
stories.summary: After a teenager died in March from his injuries in a snowboarding accident at Bogus Basin, his parents sued his medical team. The family alleged that negligent emergency response and medical treatment caused their son’s death.

stories.title: ‘Saul Goodman IRL?’: Las Vegas lawyer’s courthouse videos draw millions of views
stories.summary: His teenage son suggested the format. Now Chris Rasmussen is fielding calls, fans and critics after his iPhone courthouse videos took off.

stories.title: ‘Very humbling’: Gorman football coach calls team chaplain the ‘rock’ of the program
stories.summary: Bishop Gorman football coach Brent Browner said all of the team’s success can be traced back to longtime program chaplain Father Bill Kenny.

stories.title: Las Vegas Raiders slide in power rankings, but Fernando Mendoza stock rises
stories.summary: Las Vegas Raiders’ slide down the power rankings isn’t reflective of the feelings in Las Vegas. Fernando Mendoza is making progress and showing signs of promise, which is what’s most important.

stories.title: ‘Native art in the contemporary’: Arts District store, gallery platforms Indigenous artists
stories.summary: An arts store and gallery in downtown Las Vegas is bringing visibility to the city’s vibrant Native American people, while celebrating Indigenous culture, history and storytelling.

stories.title: Heartfelt homecoming: North Las Vegas toddler comes home for 1st time after transplant
stories.summary: After a heart transplant at UCLA in Los Angeles, 15-month-old Kian Carr has returned to his North Las Vegas home for the first time.
